clips.title: The story
paras: On Red Cloud Mesa, young hunters gather Plainstrider Feather from the birds roaming Mulgore’s plains. Camp Narache uses them for clothing and tribal adornments, honoring the creatures that provide for the village.

Young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa learn to track and hunt for what the tribe needs. Plainstriders roam the grassy plateau, providing food and useful feathers. Camp Narache makes garments and gear from their plumage. Young hunters bring feathers and fresh meat to Grull Hawkwind to meet the camp’s needs. The offering is their first test before Chief Hawkwind recognizes them and welcomes them in Thunder Bluff.
